claim.supported_scope: Two-group MICOM v2 Steps 1-3 coupled to deterministic two-tailed permutation comparisons of PLS paths, outer loadings, and outer weights with explicit Group A minus Group B direction.
claim.estimand: The compositional-correlation, pooled-score mean and log-variance differences, and two-group parameter differences under the frozen label-permutation reference distribution.
assumptions: Exactly two selected groups use an identical supported PLS model, indicator coding, preprocessing, path weighting, and listwise case treatment.
The researcher explicitly confirms MICOM Step 1 semantic and configural conditions before execution.
Permutation streams preserve group sizes and every successful group solution is sign-aligned to the pooled reference.
exclusions: More than two simultaneous groups, parametric MGA, bootstrap MGA, one-tailed MGA, omnibus tests, and multiplicity correction are excluded.
Consistent MICOM or MGA, case weights, interactions, higher-order models, and covariance-only input are excluded.
MICOM does not itself establish semantic equivalence, construct validity, causality, or population representativeness.
warnings: MGA interpretation for a composite requires at least partial MICOM invariance for that composite.
A statistically unusual group difference is not evidence of practical importance or causality.

references.citation: Henseler, Ringle, and Sarstedt (2016), Testing Measurement Invariance of Composites Using Partial Least Squares
Independent Python two-group MICOM v2 and permutation MGA calculation
Independent Python bounded two-group comparison fixture

simulations.design: Two-group full-invariance controls plus compositional, location, dispersion, and structural-difference scenarios across supported sample sizes and measurement strengths.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed label-permutation streams derived from scenario identity, master seed, and replicate index independent of workers.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The complete bounded payload must match the independent calculation within 1e-6 and meet preregistered decision and usable-permutation limits.

simulations.design: Exchangeable two-group null scenarios for supported paths, loadings, and weights.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed scenario and permutation streams with group sizes preserved exactly.
simulations.acceptance_rule: At alpha 0.05 the preregistered confidence interval must contain 0.05, its upper bound must not exceed 0.065, and no failed fit may disappear from accounting.

boundaries.case: A group has fewer than the supported complete cases or a singular supported-model fit.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Setup is blocked or the failed permutation is counted under the frozen attempt policy.

boundaries.case: The request includes more than two groups, an unsupported estimator, or missing configural confirmation.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The calculation is blocked before permutation.

boundaries.case: Group A and B labels are swapped consistently.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Signed differences reverse, absolute two-tailed p values remain equal, and MICOM decisions remain mapped correctly.

boundaries.case: The same recipe is executed with different supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Permutation assignments, successful fits, ordering, and analytical payload are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: Groups, counts, seed, MICOM decisions, differences, p values, or method identity are changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose capability identity differs from coupled MICOM and permutation MGA.
Reject a result relabeled as a different MICOM or MGA version.
Reject a result whose data fingerprint differs from its saved grouped data.
Reject any changed archive member whose checksum differs.
Reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, non-finite values, invalid counts, inconsistent directions, or invalid p-value lattices.
Never reinterpret micom_v1 or permutation MGA v1 output as v2 evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Historical multigroup results retain their original identities and cannot satisfy current v2 promotion evidence.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For identical data, group selection, settings, seed, and workers, GUI and CLI analytical payloads must be exactly equal apart from timestamps.
accessibility_rules: MICOM and MGA plots have equivalent accessible tables.
Group direction, decisions, p values, warnings, and failures are available without color alone.
